config.html:
Two business rules (decision tables) route every request:

  • CapEx approval thresholds: the tier by total cost: under $25,000 Tier 1 (department head), $25,000 to $250,000 Tier 2 (+ finance controller and CFO), over $250,000 Tier 3 (+ CEO and capital committee), each with its SLA.
  • CapEx category reviews: CIO review for IT; safety review for facilities, vehicles and equipment over $100,000. They run in parallel after the department head.

Requests over their budget line always go to the finance controller. Change requests more than 10% over the approved amount are re-approved.
